import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { territories } from "./territories";

// Introspected as a lookup: a 4-row code list: referenced by 1 table(s), references none, 3 or fewer simple columns.
export const region = defineTable("region", {
    columns: {
        regionId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        regionDescription: col.varchar(60).notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        territories: rel.hasMany(() => territories)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
